title: Career and Workplace Evidence Folio
purpose: A calm two-year record of selected career, application, communication, teamwork, finance, workplace-issue, enterprise and work-experience learning evidence.
assessment_boundary: The folio supports learning and may help a student prepare authorised task evidence. It is not an official submission channel, a mark, proof of attendance, teacher observation or a competence decision.

orientation.heading: Build one useful piece at a time
orientation.student_copy: Choose the next card your teacher has nominated. Save a focused response, explain what the evidence shows, then return later. You do not need to complete the whole folio in one sitting.
orientation.next_action_rule: Show the first incomplete teacher-nominated card; otherwise show the first incomplete card in course sequence.
orientation.not_submitted_language: Not submitted - use the submission method your teacher gives you.

persistence.autosave: Debounced after input and immediately on card completion; display local saved time without implying cloud sync.
persistence.migration: Accept version 1 only. Preserve compatible card IDs. Reject another course namespace and offer a non-destructive download of the rejected backup.
persistence.reset: Two-step, local-only reset naming the course and affected records; never clear unrelated site storage.

backup.student_copy: The editable JSON backup does not include imported images or files. Keep original evidence files separately.

submission_export.includes: Selected cards, their prompts, responses, captions, source labels and only the assets the student explicitly includes at export time.
submission_export.excludes: Unselected cards, browser history, quiz records, assessment acknowledgements and hidden assessor material.
submission_export.boundary: Creating or printing an export does not submit it.

persistence.print: A4-readable; expand selected responses, repeat card title and context, hide controls, and avoid splitting a card's prompt from its response where practical.

privacy.default: Use de-identified or fictional examples unless the teacher explicitly authorises personal evidence.
never_request: unapproved employer, client or peer identifying details
privacy.assets: Images and files remain in this browser's IndexedDB. Validate permitted types and size, show a preview and removal control, and require a caption and privacy check before export.
privacy.export_warning: Check every selected page and attachment for names, contact details, faces, workplace identifiers and other private information before export.

cards.title: Career decision snapshot
cards.action: Compare one realistic career direction with one credible alternative.
cards.why: A decision is stronger when it uses evidence and keeps another pathway visible.
cards.evidence: A two-option decision table with criteria, source notes and a short provisional choice.
cards.prompt: Which evidence matters most to your current choice, and what new evidence could change your mind?
cards.caption: Explain what this comparison proves about the way you made the decision.
support: At the moment I prefer... because...
cards.assessment_relationship: Preparation support for the confirmed 2026 Year 11 Career Progression Plan; not the official task response or submission.
cards.attachment_policy: No attachment required; optional de-identified pathway diagram only.
cards.alternative_text: Text-first comparison of two career directions with criteria, evidence and a provisional decision.

cards.title: Pathway and action plan
cards.action: Build a staged pathway with checkpoints, alternatives and one review date.
cards.why: A flexible plan turns a distant goal into useful next actions.
cards.evidence: A short-, medium- and long-term pathway table supported by at least three source records when used for Task 1 preparation.
cards.prompt: Which step is within your control now, and what is your safest alternative if one assumption changes?
cards.caption: Explain how this plan remains realistic without pretending the future is fixed.
cards.assessment_relationship: Preparation support for the confirmed 2026 Year 11 Career Progression Plan; students must follow the issued task notice for required length, sources and submission.
cards.attachment_policy: Optional exported pathway diagram; do not upload application identifiers or private correspondence.
cards.alternative_text: Three-stage pathway table with checkpoints, dependencies, barriers and an alternative route.

cards.title: Workplace participation map
cards.action: Map how one role connects to other people, responsibilities and safe participation.
cards.why: Understanding relationships helps a new worker know where to seek information and support.
cards.evidence: A de-identified role-and-relationship map plus one source-supported safe next-step scenario.
cards.prompt: Where could unclear responsibility create a problem, and who should clarify it?
cards.caption: Explain what your map shows about effective participation, not personal competence.
support: The safe next step is to check...
cards.assessment_relationship: Formative folio evidence only; no teacher-observed safety or workplace competence is inferred.
cards.attachment_policy: Use a fictional or de-identified workplace; no staff names, rostering details or restricted procedures.
cards.alternative_text: De-identified map linking a workplace role, relationships, responsibilities and safe sources of help.

cards.title: Opportunity and selection criteria map
cards.action: Annotate a current opportunity and map each criterion to honest evidence or a gap.
cards.why: Strong applications answer what the employer actually asks without exaggeration.
cards.evidence: A redacted opportunity extract, criteria-to-evidence map and two priority gaps.
cards.prompt: Which criterion can you support most convincingly, and which gap needs a practical next step?
cards.caption: Explain how your evidence map makes the application more accurate and targeted.
support: I cannot yet claim... so my next step is...
cards.assessment_relationship: Preparation support for the scheduled 2026 Year 11 Simulated Application and Workplace Interview; the current detailed notice is not yet available.
cards.attachment_policy: Redact business contacts, applicant identifiers and tracking links; do not upload a real person's application.
cards.alternative_text: Criteria-to-evidence table showing supported claims, evidence gaps and next actions.

cards.title: Evidence-based application draft
cards.action: Draft one targeted application section using truthful evidence and professional communication.
cards.why: A concise, specific claim is more credible than a list of unsupported qualities.
cards.evidence: A de-identified cover-letter paragraph or criterion response, with claim-evidence-result labels and a revision note.
cards.prompt: What can the reader verify from your example, and what wording did you remove because it overstated the evidence?
cards.caption: Explain what makes this application evidence specific and honest.
cards.assessment_relationship: Practice for the scheduled 2026 Year 11 application task; not a real application and not an official assessment submission.
cards.attachment_policy: Use a simulated or fully redacted draft; never store home address, phone, email, referee details or account credentials.
cards.alternative_text: De-identified application paragraph labelled by claim, evidence, result and revision.

cards.title: Interview and communication reflection
cards.action: Review one simulated interview or workplace conversation and plan one specific improvement.
cards.why: Reflection turns rehearsal into a communication strategy that can be reused.
cards.evidence: A question-purpose-response record, self-observation and revised response or repair script.
cards.prompt: How did your wording, listening or channel choice affect the other person's ability to understand and respond?
cards.caption: Explain what changed between the first and revised response.
cards.assessment_relationship: Practice for the scheduled 2026 Year 11 simulated interview; teacher observation and marking remain in the authorised assessment process.
cards.attachment_policy: Do not record another person's audio, image or name. A student may store their own written transcript only.
cards.alternative_text: Written interview reflection comparing an initial response with a clearer revised response.

cards.title: Team contribution and decision log
cards.action: Record one team decision, your contribution and the evidence used.
cards.why: A decision log shows how teamwork and problem-solving operated without turning peer judgement into a score.
cards.evidence: A de-identified decision record with options, roles, evidence, agreed action and review point.
cards.prompt: What did your contribution help the team understand or decide, and what would make the process fairer next time?
cards.caption: Explain what the record proves about the process, not about anyone's personal worth or competence.
support: The evidence that influenced us was...
cards.assessment_relationship: Formative evidence that may support later authorised group work; it is not a peer mark or teacher observation.
cards.attachment_policy: Use role labels rather than student names and exclude private peer feedback.
cards.alternative_text: De-identified team decision log showing roles, options, evidence, action and review.

cards.title: Work-life and money choices
cards.action: Use a fictional or rounded scenario to test how commitments and money choices affect a plan.
cards.why: Planning becomes more realistic when time, wellbeing and financial trade-offs are considered together.
cards.evidence: A privacy-safe commitments-and-budget scenario with one trade-off, one buffer and one adaptation trigger.
cards.prompt: Which choice protects the most important commitment, and what would tell you the plan needs to change?
cards.caption: Explain what the scenario teaches without disclosing your family's actual finances.
support: I would review the plan if...
cards.assessment_relationship: Formative course evidence only; not financial advice and not proof of personal financial circumstances.
cards.attachment_policy: No bank statements, payslips, tax records, account details, receipts or identifiable household budgets.
cards.alternative_text: Fictional commitments and budget scenario showing a trade-off, buffer and review trigger.

cards.title: Workplace issue inquiry
cards.action: Investigate one workplace issue using current, credible and contrasting sources.
cards.why: A sound response separates evidence, perspectives and possible action.
cards.evidence: A source-and-perspective matrix, impact statement and source-safe response pathway.
cards.prompt: What can you conclude confidently, what remains uncertain, and which current authority should be checked before action?
cards.caption: Explain how the evidence changed or strengthened your view.
cards.assessment_relationship: Formative inquiry evidence only; not legal, industrial relations or personal case advice.
cards.attachment_policy: Use public or teacher-provided sources. Do not document a live personal dispute or identify workers or organisations without authorisation.
cards.alternative_text: Evidence matrix comparing workplace-issue sources, impacts, perspectives and a verification pathway.

cards.title: Micro-enterprise proposal
cards.action: Test a small enterprise idea against a need, capability, obligation and risk.
cards.why: A useful idea needs evidence and limits, not just enthusiasm.
cards.evidence: A one-page proposal with user need, value, resources, risks, assumptions and a low-cost test.
cards.prompt: Which assumption could most quickly make the idea unworkable, and how could you test it safely?
cards.caption: Explain what evidence would support a continue, change or stop decision.
cards.assessment_relationship: Formative enterprise learning only; not business, legal, tax or financial approval.
cards.attachment_policy: Use fictional or consented research; do not collect customer contact details or payment information.
cards.alternative_text: One-page micro-enterprise proposal linking need, value, resources, obligations, risk and a small test.

cards.title: Team enterprise project record
cards.action: Select evidence showing the project purpose, one decision, one change and the final evaluation.
cards.why: A concise project record makes team reasoning and learning visible.
cards.evidence: A problem statement, success criteria, role record, decision/change log and outcome evaluation, with de-identified supporting evidence where authorised.
cards.prompt: Which project decision had the greatest effect on the result, and what evidence supports that judgement?
cards.caption: Explain what the selected project evidence proves about planning and review.
support: The result met/did not meet... as shown by...
cards.assessment_relationship: May support the scheduled 2026 Year 11 Group Practical Task, but its current task detail, criteria and authorised evidence requirements must follow your teacher’s current instructions.
cards.attachment_policy: Only teacher-authorised, consented and de-identified project evidence. Do not infer a mark, attendance, individual competence or peer performance.
cards.alternative_text: Project evidence sequence showing purpose, criteria, roles, a decision, a change and evaluation.

cards.title: Work-experience reflection and transfer plan
cards.action: Reflect on one authorised observation or simulated workplace experience and transfer the learning to a next step.
cards.why: The value of experience comes from noticing, interpreting and applying what was learned.
cards.evidence: A de-identified observation, what it suggests, one question, one transferable skill and a realistic next action.
cards.prompt: What did the experience change about your understanding, and how will you test that learning in another context?
cards.caption: Explain what the evidence shows about learning without claiming teacher-observed workplace competence.
cards.assessment_relationship: Formative reflection only. Whether Module 10 and workplace experience are used, and all approvals and evidence requirements, must follow your teacher’s current instructions.
cards.attachment_policy: No faces, workplace records, client details, restricted areas or identifying employer information without explicit school and workplace authorisation.
cards.alternative_text: De-identified work-experience reflection linking an observation, interpretation, question, transferable skill and next action.
